primary_sources.title: Walter Neumann, A calculus for plumbing applied to the topology of complex surface singularities and degenerating complex curves, Trans AMS268(1981),299-344
primary_sources.used_statement: Proposition2.1 move R6 (splitting), printed pp305-306, applied both to the closed graph and to the graph with one endpoint fiber deleted; Theorem6.1(III) and its proof, printed pp327-328, for a linear negative-two chain and lens-space slope. No lens/core marking is inferred from homology alone.
